events.title: Freddie Mercury's Passing
events.blurb: It's 35 years since we lost the iconic Queen frontman, Freddie Mercury, who passed away in 1991.

angles.name: Freddie's Legacy
angles.copy: A tribute to one of rock's most electrifying performers. His legacy continues to inspire.

events.title: The Beatles' 'Rubber Soul' Anniversary
events.blurb: The Beatles released their groundbreaking album "Rubber Soul" on this day in 1965.

angles.name: Timeless Album
angles.copy: A true turning point in pop music. 'Rubber Soul' proved The Beatles were masters of evolution.

events.title: Remembering John Lennon
events.blurb: On this day in 1980, the world mourned the loss of music icon John Lennon.

angles.name: Lennon's Enduring Message
angles.copy: His music and message of peace still resonate deeply today. A true legend gone too soon.

events.title: David Bowie would have been 80
events.blurb: Today marks what would have been the 80th birthday of the legendary David Bowie, born in 1947.

angles.name: Celebrating the Starman
angles.copy: Celebrating the Starman, a true innovator whose influence continues to shape music and culture.

events.title: Elvis Presley would have been 92
events.blurb: The King of Rock and Roll, Elvis Presley, born in 1935, would have celebrated his 92nd birthday today.

angles.name: Long Live The King
angles.copy: Still the undisputed King. His voice and charisma remain unmatched.

events.title: Jimmy Page turns 83
events.blurb: Led Zeppelin's legendary guitarist, Jimmy Page, born in 1944, celebrates his 83rd birthday today.

angles.name: Guitar God
angles.copy: The architect of some of rock's greatest riffs. Happy birthday to a true guitar god.

events.title: Rod Stewart turns 82
events.blurb: The iconic singer Rod Stewart, born in 1945, celebrates his 82nd birthday today.

angles.name: Rod The Mod
angles.copy: Still rocking after all these years! Wishing a very happy birthday to the one and only Rod the Mod.

events.title: Suggs turns 66
events.blurb: Madness frontman Suggs, Graham McPherson, born in 1961, celebrates his 66th birthday today.

angles.name: Our House Is Playing
angles.copy: Our House is playing a special tune for Suggs today. Happy birthday to the voice of Madness!

events.title: Paul Young turns 71
events.blurb: The voice behind hits like "Wherever I Lay My Hat," Paul Young, born in 1956, turns 71 today.

angles.name: Unmistakable Voice
angles.copy: Still got that unmistakable voice. Wishing a very happy birthday to the fantastic Paul Young.

events.title: Dolly Parton turns 81
events.blurb: The legendary Queen of Country, Dolly Parton, born in 1946, celebrates her 81st birthday today.

angles.name: Still Working 9 to 5
angles.copy: Still working 9 to 5 and beyond! Happy birthday to the incredible Dolly Parton.

events.title: Gary Barlow turns 56
events.blurb: Take That's lead singer and songwriter, Gary Barlow, born in 1971, celebrates his 56th birthday today.

angles.name: Magic Touch
angles.copy: Still got that magic touch with a melody. Happy birthday to the one and only Gary Barlow.

events.title: Billy Ocean turns 77
events.blurb: The chart-topping R&B singer Billy Ocean, born in 1950, celebrates his 77th birthday today.

angles.name: Get Outta Our Dreams
angles.copy: Get out of our dreams and into our cars! Happy birthday to the fantastic Billy Ocean.

events.title: Rock & Roll Hall of Fame Inaugural Ceremony Anniversary
events.blurb: The first Rock and Roll Hall of Fame induction ceremony took place on this day in 1989, honouring rock pioneers.

angles.name: Rock Royalty
angles.copy: Remembering the day rock royalty officially took its place in history. Who's your favourite inductee?

events.title: Mark Owen turns 55
events.blurb: Take That member Mark Owen, born in 1972, celebrates his 55th birthday today.

angles.name: Boyband Heartthrob
angles.copy: The boyband heartthrob is another year older! Happy birthday to Mark Owen.

events.title: The Beatles' Rooftop Concert Anniversary
events.blurb: On this day in 1969, The Beatles performed their legendary final live performance on the rooftop of Apple Corps in London.

angles.name: Iconic Moment
angles.copy: An iconic moment in music history. The Beatles' rooftop gig, still giving us chills.

events.title: Phil Collins turns 76
events.blurb: The legendary singer and drummer Phil Collins, born in 1951, celebrates his 76th birthday today.

angles.name: Drumming Up A Storm
angles.copy: Still drumming up a storm! Happy birthday to the incredible Phil Collins.

events.title: Hugh Grant turns 67
events.blurb: The beloved British actor Hugh Grant, born in 1960, celebrates his 67th birthday today.

angles.name: Floppy-Haired Charm
angles.copy: Our favourite floppy-haired rom-com star is another year older. Happy birthday, Hugh!

events.title: Justin Timberlake turns 46
events.blurb: Pop superstar Justin Timberlake, born in 1981, celebrates his 46th birthday today.

angles.name: Bringing SexyBack
angles.copy: Bringing SexyBack for another year! Happy birthday to the multi-talented Justin Timberlake.

events.title: Sir David Jason turns 87
events.blurb: The national treasure and actor Sir David Jason, born in 1940, celebrates his 87th birthday today.

angles.name: Lovely Jubbly!
angles.copy: Lovely jubbly! Wishing a very happy birthday to the legendary Sir David Jason.

events.title: The Day The Music Died Anniversary
events.blurb: On this tragic day in 1959, music lost Buddy Holly, Ritchie Valens, and The Big Bopper in a plane crash.

angles.name: Remembering The Pioneers
angles.copy: Remembering three rock and roll pioneers who left us far too soon. Their music lives on.

events.title: Rick Astley turns 61
events.blurb: The iconic 80s singer Rick Astley, born in 1966, celebrates his 61st birthday today.

angles.name: Never Gonna Give You Up
angles.copy: He's never gonna give you up, and we're never gonna forget his tunes! Happy birthday, Rick Astley.

events.title: Bob Marley would have been 82
events.blurb: The legendary reggae pioneer Bob Marley, born in 1945, would have celebrated his 82nd birthday today.

angles.name: One Love, One Legend
angles.copy: One love, one heart, one legend. Celebrating the life and music of Bob Marley.

events.title: Carole King turns 85
events.blurb: The influential singer-songwriter Carole King, born in 1942, celebrates her 85th birthday today.

angles.name: Tapestry of Genius
angles.copy: Tapestry of hits and a true musical genius. Happy birthday to the incredible Carole King.

events.title: Remembering Whitney Houston
events.blurb: On this day, we remember the unparalleled voice of Whitney Houston, who passed away in 2012.

angles.name: Voice Of A Generation
angles.copy: Her voice was truly one in a million. Remembering the incredible talent of Whitney Houston.

events.title: Take That Split Anniversary
events.blurb: It's 31 years since the devastating news broke that Take That were splitting up in 1996.

angles.name: Hearts Broke
angles.copy: The day hearts broke across the nation. Thankfully, they came back stronger than ever!

events.title: Ali Campbell turns 68
events.blurb: UB40's lead singer Ali Campbell, born in 1959, celebrates his 68th birthday today.

angles.name: Red Red Wine
angles.copy: Red, Red Wine and another year older! Happy birthday to the voice of UB40, Ali Campbell.

events.title: Ed Sheeran turns 36
events.blurb: Global superstar Ed Sheeran, born in 1991, celebrates his 36th birthday today.

angles.name: From Busking To Stadiums
angles.copy: From busking to stadiums, he's still got it. Happy birthday to the brilliant Ed Sheeran.

events.title: George Harrison would have been 84
events.blurb: The quiet Beatle, George Harrison, born in 1943, would have celebrated his 84th birthday today.

angles.name: A Musical Explorer
angles.copy: A true musical explorer. Remembering the incredible talent of George Harrison.
